# {historydata}

## Overview

These sample data sets are intended for historians learning R. They
include population, institutional, religious, military, and
prosopographical data suitable for mapping, quantitative analysis, and
network analysis.

## Installation

To install the latest
[r-universe](https://ropensci.r-universe.dev/historydata) build:

``` r

install.packages('historydata', repos = c('https://ropensci.r-universe.dev'))
```

To install the package from
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=historydata):

``` r

install.packages("historydata")
```

You can install the development version from
[GitHub](https://github.com/ropensci/historydata) with {devtools}:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("ropensci/historydata")
```

## Use

See the [package index
reference](https://docs.ropensci.org/historydata/reference/index.html)
for all the datasets in the package and their documentation. You can
also use R’s builtin help:

``` r

help(package = historydata)
```

To load a dataset directly into your environment:

``` r

data(catholic_dioceses)
head(catholic_dioceses)
#>                      diocese  rite      lat      long   event       date
#> 1        Baltimore, Maryland Latin 39.29038 -76.61219 erected 1789-04-06
#> 2     New Orleans, Louisiana Latin 29.95107 -90.07153 erected 1793-04-25
#> 3      Boston, Massachusetts Latin 42.35843 -71.05977 erected 1808-04-08
#> 4       Louisville, Kentucky Latin 38.25266 -85.75846 erected 1808-04-08
#> 5         New York, New York Latin 40.71435 -74.00597 erected 1808-04-08
#> 6 Philadelphia, Pennsylvania Latin 39.95233 -75.16379 erected 1808-04-08
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`catholic_dioceses`](https://docs.ropensci.org/historydata/reference/catholic_dioceses.md)
  : Roman Catholic dioceses in the United States, Canada, and Mexico
- [`dijon_prices`](https://docs.ropensci.org/historydata/reference/dijon_prices.md)
  [`dijon_prices_wide`](https://docs.ropensci.org/historydata/reference/dijon_prices.md)
  : Wholesale Market Prices in Dijon, France 1568–1630
- [`early_colleges`](https://docs.ropensci.org/historydata/reference/early_colleges.md)
  : Early colleges in the United States
- [`historydata`](https://docs.ropensci.org/historydata/reference/historydata.md)
  : Datasets for historians
- [`judges`](https://docs.ropensci.org/historydata/reference/judges.md)
  [`judges_appointments`](https://docs.ropensci.org/historydata/reference/judges.md)
  [`judges_people`](https://docs.ropensci.org/historydata/reference/judges.md)
  : Federal judges in the United States of America
- [`methodists`](https://docs.ropensci.org/historydata/reference/methodists.md)
  : Methodist Minutes of the Annual Conferences, 1786–1834
- [`minneapolisfed_cpi`](https://docs.ropensci.org/historydata/reference/minneapolisfed_cpi.md)
  : Consumer Price Index, 1800-2024
- [`naval_promotions`](https://docs.ropensci.org/historydata/reference/naval_promotions.md)
  : Promotions of U.S. Navy officers, 1798-1849
- [`paulist_missions`](https://docs.ropensci.org/historydata/reference/paulist_missions.md)
  : Records of missions held by the Paulist Fathers, 1851–1893
- [`presbyterians`](https://docs.ropensci.org/historydata/reference/presbyterians.md)
  : Presbyterians Statistics Through One Hundred Years
- [`quasi_war`](https://docs.ropensci.org/historydata/reference/quasi_war.md)
  : Naval encounters during the Quasi War between France and the United
  States of America
- [`sarna`](https://docs.ropensci.org/historydata/reference/sarna.md) :
  Population estimates of American Jews
- [`tudors`](https://docs.ropensci.org/historydata/reference/tudors.md)
  : Tudor dynasty
- [`us_cities_pop`](https://docs.ropensci.org/historydata/reference/us_cities_pop.md)
  : United States Historical City Populations, 1790-2010
- [`us_military_strengths`](https://docs.ropensci.org/historydata/reference/us_military_strengths.md)
  : US Military Strengths
- [`us_national_population`](https://docs.ropensci.org/historydata/reference/us_national_population.md)
  : Population of the United States, 1790-2020
- [`us_state_populations`](https://docs.ropensci.org/historydata/reference/us_state_populations.md)
  : Populations of US states and territories, 1790-2020
